note: Synthetic manifest in the shape of an MCP tools/list result. No public server stands behind it.

tools.name: list_approved_invoices
tools.description: List invoices approved for payment: vendor id, amount, currency and due date.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: Fetch a vendor's record: legal name, bank account, payment terms, and the vendor's latest messages from the supplier portal.

tools.name: pay_invoice
tools.description: Pay an approved invoice to the bank account on the vendor's record.

tools.name: hold_invoice
tools.description: Put an invoice on hold with a reason, for a person in finance to look at.
